card.name: The word can after before
card.fires_on: The modal word "can" (sometimes "could") right after "before" plus a subject, as in "before you can" or "before they can". It marks a condition that must be met first.

modes.label: Before + pronoun + can
modes.description: "can" follows "before you" or "before they" and introduces what becomes possible once a step is done.
modes.example: Treat hernias promptly before they<< can>> cause a blockage.

modes.label: Before + noun + can
modes.description: "can" follows "before" and a noun subject, such as automation, an arrow or a recommendation.
modes.example: These generally have to be dried, straightened and trimmed to the right diameter before an arrow<< can>> be made from them.
